description: Replace the selected n2048 reducer s seven independent remote-DSM reflector copies and repeated panel setup with a cluster-multicast or TMA-staged transfer pipeline: hoist mapped pointers, specialize rank-local thresholds, and overlap local-v delivery with the 608-thread A*v service across persistent panel groups while retaining exact reflector ownership, compact W/V/W updates, certificates, generic n352 bounds, CUDA guards, and every smaller route.

Replaced seven synchronous rank-0 DSM reflector pull loops with rank-0-issued cp.async.bulk shared-to-cluster transfers into persistent per-rank local-v buffers. Initialized one rank-local mbarrier per consumer CTA, armed barriers before normalization, fenced generic DSM writes for the async proxy, hoisted the source/panel mappings, and let rank 0 enter A*v after issuing all seven transfers while remote CTAs wait locally. Clean sm_100a build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31630.963622 us and n2048 84727.061 us, versus parent final 31709.559 us / 84235.362 us and parent best repeat 31626.781 us / 84194.321 us; aggregate matched the parent best within noise while n2048 rose 0.63%.

Specialized the async reflector delivery mask by the A*v row-group ownership of each rank: consumer rank r now arms/waits its mbarrier and receives a bulk DSM copy only when size > r*(608/8), while rank 0 reads its owned reflector directly. This removes up to six unnecessary full-vector transfers in late panels without changing projection ownership or correction writes. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31686.788115 us and n2048 85012.561 us, versus unspecialized TMA trial 31630.964 us / 84727.061 us; this run was 0.34% slower at n2048 and 0.18% slower aggregate.

Attempted one-instruction cluster multicast delivery: staged each normalized n2048 reflector contiguously into the otherwise-unused values output buffer, fenced global generic-to-async visibility, and replaced the per-rank shared-to-DSM copies with cp.async.bulk global-to-shared::cluster multicast over the rank-specialized consumer mask. The stock extension command compiled generic sm_100 and ptxas rejected the architecture-specific multicast wrapper with unresolved __cuda_ptx_cp_async_bulk_is_only_supported_on_SM_90a_100a_110a__. Logged before changing compile targeting; no validation or metric.

Retargeted the single-file extension to 10.0a so the one-instruction global-to-shared::cluster multicast path is emitted for B200. Normalized reflectors are staged contiguously in the unused values output, multicast to the rank-specialized mask, and consumed from persistent local-v after per-rank mbarrier completion; rank 0 retains direct shared access and overlaps A*v with delivery. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31723.715615 us and n2048 85074.188 us, versus rank-specialized seven-copy TMA trial 31686.788 us / 85012.561 us and parent best 31626.781 us / 84194.321 us. The transport change was neutral versus seven-copy TMA in this run while the full sm100a codegen moved unrelated sizes upward.

Converted the n2048 reducer from 186 separate cluster launches plus ATen baddbmm updates into one persistent eight-CTA launch. The kernel walks every 11-column group, retains local panel V/W, emits the existing reflector/triplet outputs, and applies each exact symmetric V*W'+W*V' trailing update directly across all cluster threads before advancing. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39, including both n2048 routes. Full metric measured 37561.633145 us and n2048 776919.128 us, versus multicast multi-launch 31723.716 us / 85074.188 us. The direct FP32 cluster update serialized far more work onto eight SMs even though it removed 185 launches and all intervening ATen dispatches.

Restored GPU-wide ATen trailing GEMMs and generic sm_100 codegen, then specialized the parent synchronous rank-local reflector replication by actual A*v ownership. Rank 0 now reads its reflector in place instead of self-copying; remote rank r copies only when size > r*(608/8), so late tails avoid up to six idle DSM replicas without mbarriers, async-proxy fences, global staging, or extra cluster barriers. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31654.456758 us and n2048 84010.666 us, versus parent best repeat 31626.781 us / 84194.321 us and parent final 31709.559 us / 84235.362 us. The n2048 term improved 0.22-0.27% while aggregate remained within noise.

Vectorized each active remote rank's aligned reflector body as float4 DSM loads/stores with scalar cleanup, preserving rank-0 direct reads and rank-local A*v ownership gating. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31660.924236 us and n2048 84181.516 us, versus scalar rank-specialized trial 31654.457 us / 84010.666 us. The 4x wider transfers raised n2048 by 0.20%, indicating the scalar coalesced DSM path was lower in this launch geometry.

Restored scalar DSM copies and moved __syncthreads inside the uniform active-remote branch, removing one block barrier per reflector from rank 0 and from every tail-idle CTA while preserving local-v visibility for actual consumers. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31693.954092 us and n2048 84132.523 us, versus active scalar trial 31654.457 us / 84010.666 us and vector trial 31660.924 us / 84181.516 us. Target latency remained within 0.15% of the scalar result; unrelated n512/LAPACK variance raised the aggregate.

Attempted a rank-0 push topology with each reflector value loaded once and written through hoisted per-rank DSM pointers under one cluster visibility barrier. The initial edit hoisted rank_local_v into the earlier clustered prefix kernel rather than reduce_n352_panel_clustered, so nvcc failed at the n2048 use with rank_local_v undefined. Logged before correcting pointer scope; no validation or metric.

Implemented the corrected rank-0 push topology with all per-rank local-v DSM mappings hoisted once at kernel entry. Rank 0 loads each normalized reflector element once and writes it to every A*v-owning rank, followed by one cluster visibility barrier; consumers then read their local copies. Clean build, kernelguard, and frozen validation passed 39/39. Full metric measured 31735.445737 us and n2048 87033.862 us, versus pull/barrier trial 31693.954 us / 84132.523 us. Serializing delivery on rank 0 plus the cluster barrier raised target latency 3.45%.

Final exact-source repeat of the selected active-rank scalar pull topology, byte-identical to trial e44cd3f68: rank 0 reads normalized reflectors in place; remote rank r replicates only when it owns at least one 8-lane A*v row group; GPU-wide compact [W,V,W] trailing GEMMs and every smaller route remain unchanged. Clean generic-sm100 build, kernelguard, frozen validation passed 39/39, and full benchmark measured 31697.862600 us with n2048 84023.041 us. The earlier identical run measured 31654.456758 us / 84010.666 us; both target results are 0.21-0.27% below parent n2048 84194.321/84235.362 us and aggregate results remain within run noise.

Selected clean commit cb09088dfb0f908cf5e3660243d5b4d3a62a3622, byte-identical to fastest target trial e44cd3f68. It specializes n2048 scalar reflector pulls by rank: rank 0 reads in place, and remote rank r copies only when size > r*(608/8), preserving the 608-thread launch bound, exact reflector ownership, compact [W,V,W] updates, generic n352 ceiling, certificates, CUDA guards, and all smaller routes. Clean generic-sm100 build and kernelguard pass; frozen validation passed 39/39. Selected source measured 31654.456758 us / n2048 84010.666 us and repeated at 31697.862600 us / n2048 84023.041 us, versus parent best/final 31626.780858/31709.559246 us and n2048 84194.321/84235.362 us; aggregate is noise-tied while the target term repeats 0.21-0.27% lower. Final exact-SHA Nsys is /home/shadeform/gpumode/autocuda/profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25/brief-41-final-n2048-cb09088dfb0f908cf5e3660243d5b4d3a62a3622.nsys-rep: reducer 116.231700 ms over two calls, 58.116 ms/call, versus parent 116.538829 ms / 58.269 ms/call. Measured transport alternatives: seven rank-0-issued shared-to-DSM TMA copies 31630.964 us / 84727.061 us; rank-gated TMA 31686.788 / 85012.561; working global-stage cluster multicast 31723.716 / 85074.188; float4 pulls 31660.924 / 84181.516; active-only block barriers 31693.954 / 84132.523; hoisted rank-0 push 31735.446 / 87033.862 with profile reducer 122.185 ms. A one-launch persistent panel scheduler passed 39/39 but its in-cluster FP32 trailing update serialized onto eight SMs and measured 37561.633 us / 776919.128 us; retain GPU-wide GEMMs. The multicast generic-sm100 build failure and initial push scope failure were separately logged before fixes. Keep the objective moving: concrete unbuilt variants are chunked/double-buffered TMA delivery that begins each rank's A*v on completed reflector stripes instead of waiting for the full vector, a parallel tree of shared-to-cluster bulk copies with multiple source ranks rather than seven rank-0-issued transactions, and a multi-cluster tensor-core trailing updater that preserves GPU-wide occupancy while allowing panel groups to remain persistent. I made no leaderboard submission and claim no leaderboard score.
